/bin/bash -lc "git diff --check && git diff -- src/data/lyrics/tu-jise-husain.md && python - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
p = Path('src/data/lyrics/tu-jise-husain.md')
_, front, body = p.read_text().split('---', 2)
roman = front.split('romanLyrics: |-\\n', 1)[1]
def blocks(text):
    return [part.splitlines() for part in text.strip().split('\\n\\n')]
r, s = blocks(roman), blocks(body)
assert [len(b) for b in r] == [len(b) for b in s]
assert [b[0].strip() for b in r[2:]] == list('12345678')
assert [b[0] for b in s[2:]] == list('۱۲۳۴۵۶۷۸')
assert all(ord(c) < 128 or c in 'ṅṄ' for c in roman)
print('Verse counts:', sum(map(len, r))-8, sum(map(len, s))-8)
PY"
